title: OCI Holders Can Travel to India While Passport Update Is Pending
excerpt: Consular guidance says travel is unrestricted between a new passport's issue and final acknowledgement of the online OCI update — but the 90-day update deadline still applies.
body:
• OCI cardholders can travel to and from India from the date a new passport is issued until their online passport update is finally acknowledged — they do not have to wait for the update to clear.
  • The update itself is still mandatory: upload the new passport and a recent photo under OCI Miscellaneous Services on the OCI portal within 3 months (90 days) of the new passport's issue, free of charge within that window.
  • Reader action: travel with your new passport, your existing OCI card, your old passport if you have it, and a printed copy of your update acknowledgement or status page for airline check-in.
  • A fresh OCI application is not required just because the passport number changed, except for the specific re-issue case after turning 20 described in official guidance.

Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) cardholders who have just renewed their foreign passport can travel to and from India while their online passport update is still being processed. Indian consular guidance restated in a September 2026 clarification attributed to the Consulate General of India in Atlanta, and reported by VisaVerge, says there is no restriction on travel during the window between the new passport's issue date and the final acknowledgement of the update in the online system.

What the Clarification Actually Says

The permission covers a specific gap that has caused anxiety at check-in desks: a traveller holds a new passport whose number differs from the one printed in the OCI record, and the online update has been filed but not yet acknowledged. Official mission guidance states the same rule in plain terms. The Embassy of India in Bogota's OCI guidance says there will be no restriction on the cardholder travelling to or from India during the period from the date of issue of the new passport until the date of final acknowledgement of the documents in the online system. The Consulate General of India in Auckland publishes the identical position for its applicants.

The Update Is Still Required — and Timed

Travel permission is not an exemption from updating. Every OCI cardholder must update passport particulars each time a new passport is issued, irrespective of age, by uploading a copy of the new passport and a latest photograph through OCI Miscellaneous Services on the OCI Services portal. The documents should be uploaded within three months of receipt of the new passport, and the service is provided free within that period. VisaVerge notes a US$25 late penalty may apply if details are updated after 90 days. Cardholders registered as the foreign spouse of an Indian citizen or OCI holder must additionally upload a declaration that the marriage is still subsisting, along with the spouse's passport or OCI copy.

One exception needs care: a cardholder who received OCI registration before turning 20 must have the card re-issued once when a new passport is issued after completing 20 years of age, so adult facial features are captured. That is a re-issue case, not the simple online update described above.

What to Carry When You Travel

Airline staff may not know the current procedure, so the documents that link your new passport to your OCI record do the explaining. Carry the valid new passport, the existing OCI card or booklet issued against the previous passport, the old passport if it is available, and a printed acknowledgement or status page showing the update has been submitted. An auto-email confirming successful upload is sent by the system once documents are submitted. If a traveller arrives without having updated valid passport details at all, official guidance warns immigration authorities may issue an oral warning and stamp the OCI card requiring compliance within one month or before departure from India, whichever is earlier — another reason to file the update before flying, even though travel during processing is allowed.

Why This Matters for the Diaspora

Passport renewals in the US, Canada and elsewhere routinely land close to long-planned India trips for weddings, festivals and family emergencies. Under the clarified position, a renewal no longer forces a choice between postponing travel and waiting for an acknowledgement that can take weeks. File the update on the portal within the 90-day window, keep the printed acknowledgement with your travel documents, and the trip can proceed on the existing OCI card.
